execution_provider_request.note: ORT Web does not expose per-node placement; this proves the requested session provider and does not claim every node executed on the GPU.

metadata.context_padding: neutral single-token spaces inserted immediately before the assistant marker

latency_boundaries.harness_ttfa: immediately before prompt tokenization through independent schema validation
latency_boundaries.runtime_ttfa: runtime prompt tokenization through runtime parse/schema validation
latency_boundaries.ttfa_ms: backward-compatible exact alias of harness_ttfa_ms; not an additional clock
latency_boundaries.ttft: runtime inference submission through first sampled token

metadata.timeout_contract: runtime exceptions become finite failure rows; hangs are not yet cancellable and abort collection

metadata.artifact_hash_contract: model, heads, metadata, dispatch, and tokenizer assets are fetched as bytes, SHA-256 and size checked in-browser against bundle-manifest.json before parsing or ORT session creation; ORT receives the verified in-memory model bytes
